data.long_meaning: One who assists, a helper or supporter. The name Araaid carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Araaid usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Araaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Araaid total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عرائض
in_arabic.long_meaning: العرائض هو اسم يعود إلى الجذر العربي 'عرض' والذي يعني تقديم أو إظهار شيء ما. في اللغة العربية، العرائض تعني العروض والملابس والبسطات. وفي سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، قد يُعطى هذا الاسم دلالة على السخاء والعطاء والكرم.

in_urdu.name: عرائض
in_urdu.meaning: عرائض کا مطلب ہے پیش کرنا، ظاہر کرنا، مال و دولت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عرائض ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'عرض' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پیش کرنا یا ظاہر کرنا. اردو میں، عرائض کا ترجمہ ہوتا ہے مال و دولت، ثروت، یا پیشکش. اسلامی ناموں کے سیاق میں، یہ نام سخاء، عطاء، اور کرم کی علامت ہو سکتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: عرائض
in_hindi.meaning: अराइज़ का अर्थ है प्रस्तुत करना, प्रकट करना, धन और संपत्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अराइज़ एक अरबी नाम है जो 'عرض' (अरज़) के मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रस्तुत करना या प्रकट करना. हिंदी में, अराइज़ का अनुवाद होता है धन और संपत्ति, समृद्धि, या प्रस्तुति. इस्लामी नामों के संदर्भ में, यह नाम उदारता, दान, और परोपकार का प्रतीक हो सकता है.

in_pashto.name: عرض
in_pashto.meaning: د عرض معنی دى تقديم يا ښکاره کول، شتمنۍ، مال
in_pashto.long_meaning: عرض د عربي کلمې 'عرض' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې دى تقديم يا ښکاره کول. په پښتو کې، عرض معنی لري شتمنۍ، مال، يا پيسې. د اسلامي نومونو په سياق کې، دا نوم سخاوت، بښش، او کرم نښه کولی شي.

in_english.name: Araaid
in_english.meaning: Araaid means to present, display, or offer something
in_english.long_meaning: The name Araaid originates from the Arabic root 'عرض' (ʿarḍ), which means to present, display, or offer something. In Islamic tradition, Araaid may symbolize generosity, charity, and benevolence. Historically, the term has been used to describe offerings or presentations made to others. The name Araaid carries a rich cultural significance across Muslim communities, reflecting values of kindness and hospitality.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عرض (a-rəz)

data.cultural_impact: The name "Araaid" holds immense cultural significance as it signifies being a helper or supporter for others. In Islamic tradition, providing support and assistance to the needy, the weak, and the vulnerable is highly esteemed and encouraged, making the name Araaid an inspiring one. This cultural impact can be seen in various aspects of Muslim community life, from charitable organizations providing aid to those in need, to individuals volunteering their time and resources to help others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Araaid" holds deep significance as it reflects the Prophetic character of Muhammad (PBUH) who is known as "Rasulul Khair" or the "Prophet of Goodness." The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) showed utmost kindness, compassion, and love towards all creation, and encouraged his followers to do the same. By being an "Araaid," or a helper and supporter, one is not only reflecting the Prophetic character but also partaking in the noble deeds that bring about peace and harmony in the community and in the world. Through small acts of kindness, generosity, and support, one can positive impact the lives of others and attain spiritual growth and closeness to Allah.
